item.title: The Floor That Kept the Dead — Neolithic Çatalhöyük Subfloor Burials (Haddow 2025), Shifting Intra-Building Genetic Kinship Across 1,000 Years (63% to 22%, Yaka 2021 & Yüncü 2025) & Maternal Lineage Ties
item.description: Stratigraphic bioarchaeology and ancient DNA of subfloor house burials across Neolithic Anatolia: Haddow et al.'s (2025) house-life-cycle burial patterns at Çatalhöyük (including Building 42's foundation burial), Yaka et al.'s (2021) transition from biological kin burials at Aşıklı Höyük/Boncuklu to co-burial of unrelated individuals, and Yüncü et al.'s (2025) 131-genome time series revealing declining intra-building genetic kinship (63% -> 30% -> 22%), maternal house linkages, and female subadult grave goods.

item.title: The Pause That Finally Had a Time — Implantable Loop Recorder Asystole Masquerading as Epilepsy (Kanjwal 2010) vs. 38-Second Ictal Asystole on Simultaneous EEG/ECG (Nandkeolyar 2018), RAST Yield & Recorder Artifacts
item.description: Behind the Curtain of ambulatory ECG and implantable loop recording (H041): Kanjwal et al.'s (2010) loop-recorder capture of complete heart block and prolonged asystole causing convulsive syncope previously treated as epilepsy, contrasted with Nandkeolyar et al.'s (2018) simultaneous video-EEG/ECG capture of right temporal seizure onset preceding a 38-second ictal asystole, Krahn's randomized RAST diagnostic yield (14/27 vs. 6/30), and Domenichini's (2023) false-positive pause artifacts.

item.title: The Staircase in the Scan — Postmortem CT, Photogrammetry & VR Stair-Fall Reconstruction (31/35 cm Injury Spacing vs. 32 cm Tread Depth), CPR Rib-Fracture CT vs. Autopsy Discordance & Ontario Fatal Stair Falls
item.description: Forensic radiology and 3D spatial reconstruction of fatal stair falls: Fukuda et al.'s (2025) alignment of postmortem CT skeletal meshes, autopsy surface-injury photogrammetry (31 cm and 35 cm inter-injury intervals), and scene stair tread depth (32 cm); Hamanaka et al.'s (2020) paired comparison of CT vs. autopsy detection of complete vs. buckle rib fractures after CPR; and Legaspi et al.'s (2023) 159 confirmed Ontario fatal stair falls.

item.title: The Drug That Cut the Drug — Glucarpidase Methotrexate Rescue, DAMPA Immunoassay Cross-Reactivity vs. HPLC/LC-MS/MS (5.79 vs. 2.27 µmol/L at Hour 117, Gulley 2020), Ogawa Tissue Rebound & Organ Recovery
item.description: Enzymatic drug cleavage and analytical cross-reactivity after high-dose methotrexate rescue with glucarpidase (carboxypeptidase G2): Gulley et al.'s (2020) split specimen 74 hours post-glucarpidase reading 5.79 µmol/L by immunoassay vs. 2.27 µmol/L by HPLC due to DAMPA metabolite persistence beyond the nominal 48-hour VORAXAZE label window, Ogawa et al.'s (2024) 98.83% 20-minute plasma drop and tissue rebound, and Corbisier et al.'s (2024) multimodal pediatric liver/renal recovery.

item.title: The Iron Test Before the School Bell — Non-Anemic Adolescent Iron Deficiency (TSAT 9.5%, Ferritin 10 µg/L), Human Ferroportin–Hepcidin Cryo-EM (6WBV), Alternate-Day Isotope Absorption & Thai vs. Baltimore School Trials
item.description: Separating storage biomarkers from classroom endpoints in iron deficiency without anemia: assay reference intervals vs. WHO/2026 AAP ferritin thresholds, human ferroportin–hepcidin cryo-EM occlusion and Co2+/Fe2+-coupled binding (PDB 6WBV, Kd 210 -> 2.5 nM), Stoffel's erythrocyte stable-isotope absorption trial (16.3% daily vs. 21.8% alternate-day), and Sungthong's Thai school trial (n=397) vs. Bruner's Baltimore verbal-learning RCT (n=81).

item.title: The Click With No Trace — Canine Unilateral BAER Deafness (Plonek English Setter & Lewis 8,955 UK Dalmatians) vs. Pediatric Auditory Neuropathy Recovery with Normal Speech & Absent Click ABR
item.description: Comparative auditory diagnostics across species (H050 & V034): Plonek's unilaterally deaf English Setter BAER waveforms and Lewis's 8,955-dog UK Dalmatian screening cohort (1,201 unilateral, 397 bilateral, 8 equivocal) paired with Starr's classic auditory neuropathy series and Eom's child with absent click ABR yet normal pure-tone thresholds and language.

item.title: The Lunch That Looked Like an Allergy — Scombroid Histamine Fish Poisoning, Paris Yellowfin Tuna Outbreak (40 Cases, 39/79 Attack Rate), Heat-Stable Histidine Decarboxylation & Supply-Chain Forensics
item.description: Outbreak epidemiology and food toxicology of scombroid histamine fish poisoning: Velut et al.'s (2019) Paris military-canteen yellowfin tuna outbreak (40 cases, 39/79 tuna diners vs. 31-case/63-control questionnaire), bacterial histidine decarboxylation into heat-stable histamine mimicking IgE anaphylaxis, CDC 2006 Louisiana/Tennessee tuna traceback contrasts, and FDA CPG 540.525 surveillance rules.

item.title: What the Sugar Test Sees — Pediatric Growth Faltering, Claudin-15 Pore Architecture (4P79), Lactulose:Rhamnose Concentration (0.50) vs. Recovery Ratio (0.10), EED Biopsy Morphometry & MAL-ED / WASH Benefits
item.description: Deconstructing dual-sugar intestinal permeability testing in pediatric growth faltering and environmental enteric dysfunction (EED): mouse claudin-15 crystal coordinates (PDB 4P79) vs. neutral sugar probes, why identical 30-90 minute urine bags yield 0.50 by concentration vs. 0.10 by fractional dose recovery on LC-MS/MS, EEDBI duodenal villus morphometry (n=96), MAL-ED (n=1,469), and WASH Benefits Bangladesh (n=4,584).

item.title: The Amino Acid at the Brain's Gate — Six-Competitor Plasma Tryptophan Ratio, Human LAT1 Cryo-EM (8J8M/8XPU), TPH2 & PET Tracer Assumptions, Delgado's Remission Relapse Trials (14/21; 8/15 vs. 1/15) & Breakfast Limits
item.description: From plasma amino-acid competition at blood-brain barrier LAT1–CD98hc (PDB 8J8M L-Trp & 8XPU JPH203) to acute tryptophan depletion trials: UHPLC-MS/MS separation of isobaric Leu/Ile, recombinant TPH2 kinetics vs. alpha-[11C]methyl-L-Trp PET assumptions, Delgado's remitted depression crossover (14/21) and SSRI vs. desipramine responder split (8/15 vs. 1/15), and why Wurtman's breakfast study measured plasma ratios rather than mood.

item.title: The Feed That Changed the Carcass — Swine Ractopamine Stereoisomers at Porcine β1/β2-AR, Dietary Lysine Nitrogen-Retention Factorial Trials, AOAC Tissue LC-MS/MS (m/z 302.1→164.1) & Codex vs. FDA vs. EU Frameworks
item.description: Comparative pharmacology, swine nutrition, and food-residue analytics of ractopamine: Andretta's 3,786-pig meta-analysis, RR/RS/SR/SS stereoisomer selectivity at cloned porcine beta1/beta2 adrenoceptors (Mills 2003) vs. human beta2AR structures (4LDO/3SN6), Ross & Pérez lysine-ractopamine interactions vs. Tous drug-free rations, AOAC 2011.23 parent vs. hydrolyzed LC-MS/MS, pig transport heart rate, and JECFA/FDA/Codex/EFSA regulatory splits.

item.title: Three Sodium Levels, Two Diets, One Blood Pressure — Controlled DASH-Sodium Feeding Trial (n=412, −8.9 mmHg Path), 24-Hour Urinary Excretion, Human NCC–Hydrochlorothiazide Cryo-EM (9BWT), Urinary Vesicles & GWAS Limits
item.description: Controlled feeding trials meet distal-tubule atomic physiology: Sacks et al.'s (2001) DASH-Sodium parallel-diet/crossover-salt design (n=412, why non-additive interaction yields -8.9 mmHg rather than -12.6 mmHg), energy-scaled sodium density vs. 24h urine potentiometry, human phosphorylated NCC and hydrochlorothiazide cryo-EM (PDB 9BWT), KCl urinary extracellular vesicle readouts, and UK Biobank/CHARGE MTHFS gene-diet slope limits.

item.title: The Fat That Stayed in the Bone — Paradoxical Bone Marrow Adiposity in Anorexia Nervosa, 3T L4 vs. Femoral PRESS 1H-MRS, Marrow Adiponectin & Human ADIPOR2 Crystal (5LX9), 12-Month Epiphyseal Divergence & P1NP/β-CTX
item.description: Why vertebral bone marrow fat rises during peripheral fat depletion in anorexia nervosa: Bredella's 3T PRESS 1H-MRS lipid/water ratios vs. areal DXA Z-scores, Cawthorn's Ocn-Wnt10b mouse calorie-restriction adiponectin experiments and human ADIPOR2 zinc-ceramidase structure (PDB 5LX9), Fazeli's 12-month longitudinal surprise (+25.3% femoral epiphyseal marrow fat alongside rising lumbar BMD), and P1NP/beta-CTX/LSC clinical boundaries.

item.title: The Number the Antidote Raised — Digoxin Immune Fab Redistribution vs. Immunoassay Interference, Ultrafiltration Free Digoxin (Jortani 1999), Renal Rebound Kinetics (Ujhelyi 1993) & Chronic Cardiogenic Shock
item.description: Separating true pharmacokinetic tissue redistribution from platform-dependent immunoassay interference after digoxin immune Fab: Smith et al. (1976) 12-fold total serum rise with undetectable free digoxin, Jortani et al. (1999) ultrafiltrate immunoassay bias across platforms, Ujhelyi et al. (1993) delayed free-digoxin rebound in renal dysfunction, and Gerritsma et al. (2025) chronic digoxin cardiogenic shock.

item.title: Epochs, Dipoles, and Saltatory Sparks — Attended Polysomnography, Hypopnea Rules & HSAT Dilution (H044), Scalp & ICU Continuous EEG (H045) & Nerve Conduction Studies and Needle EMG (H046)
item.description: Clinical Cluster & Neurophysiology synthesis of attended polysomnography (H044), scalp/ICU EEG (H045), and NCS/needle EMG (H046): 3% vs. 4% hypopnea rules, pediatric >=2-breath cutoffs, HSAT TRT dilution, RBD synucleinopathy, and CHAT (n=464); 6-10 cm2 cortical dipole threshold, wicket-spike traps, Claassen ICU cEEG (n=570, 92% non-convulsive), and TELSTAR (n=172); and small-fiber blindness, the DRG SNAP law, 10-21 day Wallerian clock, MG vs. LEMS facilitation, cool-limb sodium physics, Martin-Gruber, and Gold Coast ALS criteria.

item.title: Scopes, Folds, and Bronchial Stations — Diagnostic Upper GI Endoscopy, GLP-1/PPI Traps & Biopsy Maps (H047), Colonoscopy BBPS, ADR & Cold Snare Quality (H048) & Bronchoscopy, BAL, Cryobiopsy & N3-to-N1 EBUS Staging (H049)
item.description: Clinical Cluster & Interventional Endoscopy synthesis of upper GI endoscopy (H047), colonoscopy quality (H048), and bronchoscopy/EBUS (H049): GLP-1 aspiration and PPI washout rules, 4 normal-mucosa biopsy maps, Lau NEJM 2020, and Forrest IIa hemostasis; BBPS >=2/segment law, Corley ADR (n=314,872), cold snare, tattoo placement, and microscopic colitis; and rigid airway rescue, BAL DAH signatures, clopidogrel TBLB bleeding, COLDICE cryobiopsy, and N3->N2->N1 EBUS-TBNA staging.

item.title: Decibels, Diopters, and Millimeters of Mercury — Audiometry, Shadow-Curve Masking, SSCD & NICU ANSD (H050), ETDRS Acuity, Pinhole Optics & Cycloplegic Refraction (H051) & Goldmann 3.06 mm Tonometry, OHTS & Normal-Tension Glaucoma (H052)
item.description: Clinical Cluster & Sensory Biophysics synthesis of audiometry (H050), visual acuity/refraction (H051), and tonometry (H052): unmasked shadow curves, 2 kHz Carhart notch, schwannoma WRS rollover, SSCD stapedial reflex rescue, and NICU OAE+/ABR- ANSD; ETDRS LogMAR, paradoxical pinhole worsening, cycloplegic pseudomyopia, and 20/20 bitemporal hemianopia; and Goldmann 3.06 mm physics, OHTS CCT, post-LASIK PISK, and Tajimi/CNTGS Normal-Tension Glaucoma.

item.title: Nasopharyngeal Thresholds, Placentomes, and Polybasic Cleavage — Human Respiratory Pathogen NAAT, IS481 Pseudo-Outbreaks & FluPOC (H023), Livestock Pregnancy Ultrasound & Sexing (V045), Swine PRRS Processing Fluids (V047) & Poultry HPAI Furin Cleavage (V048)
item.description: One Medicine Comparative Respiratory Virology, Theriogenology & Biosecurity synthesis of human respiratory NAAT (H023), livestock pregnancy ultrasound (V045), swine PRRS (V047), and poultry avian influenza (V048): ICU lower-tract & adult RSV multispecimen yields, Ct/viability kinetics, the 2006 IS481 pertussis pseudo-outbreak, FluPOC (n=613), and Hamburg forensic autopsies (n=80); bovine fetal sexing & goat hydrometra; PRRS processing fluids & tonsillar persistence; and HPAI polybasic cleavage, BHI swab chemistry, and duck AGID blindness.

item.title: Gill Lamellae, Trunk Kidneys, Exhaust Dust, and Brainstems — Teleost Gill Wet Mounts & Gas Bubble Disease (V053), Aquatic Kidney Culture, 37°C Traps & FDA VFDs (V054), Lab Rodent Exhaust Air Dust PCR (V055) & Wildlife Rabies DFA & CDC LN34 RT-qPCR (V056)
item.description: One Medicine Capstone synthesis of teleost wet mounts (V053), fish bacteriology (V054), lab rodent surveillance (V055), and wildlife rabies testing (V056): 15m gill autolysis clock, buffered MS-222, Gyrodactylus vs. Dactylogyrus, and Gas Bubble Disease; Posterior Trunk Kidney culture, 15-28C thermal/TYES media, CLSI VET03/04, and FDA VFD law; IVC Exhaust Air Dust qPCR, NSG serology traps, binomial n=299 math, and LCMV biologics PCR; and bilateral Brainstem+Cerebellum DFA, CDC LN34 decomposed-brain rescue, cryptic bedroom bats, and FAVN titers.

item.title: Windows, Workloads, and Diffusing Gas — Ambulatory ECG Cadence & EMBRACE/CRYSTAL AF Trials (H041), Exercise Stress Physiology, HRR & ISCHEMIA (H042) & Plethysmographic Lung Volumes & DLCO/KCO (H043)
item.description: Clinical Cluster & Cardiopulmonary Physiology synthesis of ambulatory ECG monitoring (H041), cardiac exercise stress testing (H042), and lung volumes/DLCO (H043): Barrett's paired patch cohort (n=146), EMBRACE (n=572) & CRYSTAL AF (n=441), nocturnal vagal variants, and toothbrush pseudo-VT; coronary autoregulation, ST localization laws, LBBB vasodilator rule, Cole's HRR (n=2,428), WOMEN & ISCHEMIA; and Boyle's Law plethysmography vs. gas dilution, Roughton-Forster DLCO/KCO physics, CPFE/PAH phenotypes, ppo-DLCO, and race-neutral GLI Z-scores.

item.title: Reflexes, Recall, and Four Plastic Tubes — Bedside Neurologic Localization & HINTS vs. Early MRI (H053), Cognitive & Neuropsychological Storage-vs-Retrieval Profiling (H054) & Lumbar Puncture, 4-Tube Xanthochromia & CSF Signatures (H055)
item.description: Clinical Cluster & Clinical Neuroscience synthesis of standardized neurologic localization (H053), neuropsychological profiling (H054), and CSF analysis (H055): forehead-sparing CN VII, Romberg proprioception, FOUR Score, HINTS beating early DWI MRI, and Hoover sign; CVLT-3 storage vs. retrieval rescue, DLB haloperidol ban, TOPF norms, and TOMM validity; and Hasbun pre-LP CT + immediate antibiotics, 450-460 nm xanthochromia, CSF lactate, <72h HSV-1 PCR traps, and Lancet 2018 atraumatic needles (n=31,412).

item.title: Half-Lives, Pancreatic Epitopes, and Portal Shunts — Human Therapeutic Drug Monitoring, Vancomycin AUC24 & Winter-Tozer/DigiFab Traps (H056), Canine/Feline Monoclonal Spec cPL/fPL & Triaditis (V025) & Dynamic Paired Bile Acids, Maltese Artifacts & PSS vs. MVD (V026)
item.description: One Medicine synthesis of human therapeutic drug monitoring (H056), canine/feline pancreatic lipase (V025), and dynamic serum bile acid stimulation (V026): phenytoin zero-order kinetics & Winter-Tozer free fraction, digoxin 6-8h & post-DigiFab traps, Bayesian vancomycin AUC24/MIC, and EDTA whole-blood tacrolimus LC-MS/MS; Spec cPL/fPL vs. catalytic lipase failure, feline shared-ampulla Triaditis + B12, cTLI for EPI, and foreign-body bystander cPL; and 12h/2h bile acids, the jaundice ban, Maltese chromogens, and Protein C (<70% PSS vs. >=70% benign MVD).

item.title: Tears, Stria Melanocytes, and Spinal Arcs — Veterinary Ophthalmic Exam, Descemetocele 'Donut Hole' & TonoVet Physics (V033), BAER Deafness Screening, MITF/PMEL Stria Collapse & Cavalier PSOM (V034) & Neurologic Localization, Schiff-Sherrington & the Deep Pain Law (V035)
item.description: One Medicine synthesis of veterinary ophthalmology/tonometry (V033), BAER deafness screening (V034), and neurologic localization (V035): STT-I sequence, cherry-eye gland preservation, descemetocele fluorescein 'donut hole', collar/species TonoVet traps, and fellow-eye glaucoma prophylaxis; Strain's >12,000 Dalmatian registry, MITF/KIT stria melanocytes, OFA >=35d rule, and Cavalier PSOM bone BAER; and 4 spinal segments, Schiff-Sherrington, paradoxical vestibular tilt, and Olby's Deep Pain & Progressive Myelomalacia laws.

item.title: Villi, Low-Protein Cytolysis, and Silicone Gels — Veterinary GI Endoscopy, Corn-Oil Lacteals & Feline Ileal Lymphoma (V036), CSF Lumbar Flow, 30-Min Lysis & Neuro-FIP Cure (V037) & Vet TDM, SST Gel Traps & Feline KBr Asthma Ban (V038)
item.description: One Medicine synthesis of veterinary GI endoscopy (V036), CSF analysis (V037), and veterinary TDM (V038): left lateral positioning, Fleet enema ban, corn-oil lacteals, and feline ileal-only T-cell lymphoma (18-39%); pre-tap MRI, lumbar vs. cisternal CSF, 30-60m oncotic lysis rescue (10% serum/Hetastarch), SRMA IgA, GS-441524 neuro-FIP cure, and equine EPM SAG ratios; and plain red-top vs. SST phenobarbital trap, feline KBr/diazepam bans, KBr chloride kinetics, cyclosporine IL-2 mRNA PD, and feline methimazole CKD unmasking.

item.title: Hoof Lamellae, Autumn Photoperiods, and Perineural Blocks — Equine Insulin Dysregulation, IGF-1 Clamp Founder & Karo OST (V040), Equine PPID Autumn ACTH Surge & 10-Min TRH Stim (V041) & Equine Lameness Kinematics, PDNB Scope & Grade 4-5 Fracture Ban (V042)
item.description: One Medicine Equine Endocrinology & Orthopedics synthesis of insulin dysregulation (V040), PPID (V041), and lameness analgesia (V042): Asplin/de Laat IGF-1R hoof clamp proof, Immulite platform cutoffs, Karo OST, and SGLT2 hyperlipemia checks; D2 melanotrope biology, Aug-Oct autumn ACTH peak sensitivity (Copas 2012), 10-min TRH stim, and paired insulin; and Kelmer/Keegan compensatory head-nod laws, the Grade 4-5 fracture radiograph rule, Easter/Schumacher PDNB scope, 5-10m diffusion, and standing foot MRI.

item.title: Nucleated Blood, Elementary Bodies, and Vitellogenic Calcium — Companion Bird Hematology & Lead Rubricytosis (V049), Avian Chlamydiosis 3-Site PCR & 45-Day Doxycycline (V050), Reptile Chemistry & Vitellogenesis (V051) & Reptile Coprology Traps (V052)
item.description: One Medicine Exotic, Avian & Herpetological synthesis of companion bird hematology (V049), avian chlamydiosis (V050), reptile hematology/biochemistry (V051), and reptile coprology (V052): Natt-Herrick/Phloxine B, psittacine genus differentials, and lead rubricytosis; C. psittaci zoonosis, 3-site PCR + EBA/IFA, and 45-day doxycycline; chelonian EDTA lysis, lymph dilution, Reptarenavirus, Ca:P/uric acid, and vitellogenic hypercalcemia; and feeder-mouse pseudoparasites, Entamoeba invadens, reptile Cryptosporidium, and chelonian ivermectin toxicity.

item.title: Precession, Echoes, and Chamber Geometry — Human MRI Spin Physics, Macrocyclic Gadolinium & PRECISION/WAKE-UP Trials (H033), Diagnostic & Bedside Ultrasound Cutoffs (H034) & Hemodynamic Echocardiography (H035)
item.description: Clinical Cluster & Diagnostic Physics synthesis of human MRI (H033), diagnostic/bedside ultrasonography (H034), and hemodynamic echocardiography (H035): Larmor spin physics, DWI/ADC shine-through, macrocyclic gadolinium safety (0/4,931 NSF), legacy pacemaker MRI (2,103 scans), PRECISION/WAKE-UP trials, and asymptomatic spine/knee cascades; 1,540 m/s range calibration, carotid string-sign paradox, Doubilet first-trimester safety cutoffs, STONE (n=2,759), and Pivetta lung ultrasound (n=1,005); and Simpson LVEF, SUCCOUR GLS, Bernoulli/Continuity valve math, RECOVERY (n=145), TTE vs. TEE endocarditis, tamponade, and acute PE.

item.title: Photons, Thresholds, and Tracers — Mammography, Tomosynthesis & Dense-Breast Screening (H036), DXA Bone Density, Spondylosis Artifacts & NORA/SCOOP Paradoxes (H037) & Nuclear Medicine SPECT/PET-CT Theranostics (H038)
item.description: Clinical Cluster & Diagnostic Physics synthesis of mammography/DBT (H036), DXA bone densitometry (H037), and nuclear medicine SPECT/PET-CT (H038): Friedewald DBT (n=454,850), DENSE MRI (n=40,373), BI-RADS discordance, and 1,000-woman screening funnels; DXA spondylosis false elevation, LSC math, NORA (n=200,160) & SCOOP (n=12,483), and pre-drug osteomalacia screening; and FDG superscans, proPSMA (n=302), SPECT balanced ischemia vs. PET CFR, cold myeloma vs. flare, PIOPED II V/Q, I-131 fetal thyroid protection, and Deauville 1-5.

item.title: Shadows, Sound, and Spin — Human Musculoskeletal Radiography & Occult Fractures (H031), Veterinary Allometric Echocardiography & EPIC/TMT Cohorts (V015) & Brain/Spinal Neuro-MRI (V017)
item.description: One Medicine synthesis of human musculoskeletal radiography (H031), veterinary echocardiography (V015), and veterinary neuro-MRI (V017): Ottawa rules, occult scaphoid/hip cohorts, 10-14 day osteomyelitis lag, and 21-view forensic surveys; allometric cardiac scaling (BW^0.294), EPIC (n=360), feline Transient Myocardial Thickening (n=21), and Doppler 4V^2 math; and Ito's 71-dog myelomalacia prognostic rule, post-ictal piriform mimics, dorsal microchip voids, and pre-CSF herniation checks.

item.title: How Cells Tie Growth to Available Nutrients — Heitman & Hall's Yeast FPR1/TOR1/TOR2 Rapamycin Mutants, Sabatini & Brown's Mammalian mTOR Affinity Capture & Hara's Amino-Acid Withdrawal Gate
item.description: Discovery of the TOR nutrient-sensing pathway: Heitman, Movva & Hall (1991) genetic screen in Saccharomyces cerevisiae showing rapamycin requires FKBP12 (FPR1) to inhibit TOR1/TOR2, Sabatini et al. (1994) & Brown et al. (1994) biochemical capture of the ~289 kDa mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) only when rapamycin is bound to FKBP12, Barbet et al. (1996) starvation-like translation arrest, and Hara et al. (1998) amino-acid gating of insulin-stimulated p70S6K phosphorylation.

item.title: How a Cell Builds Insulin from One Chain — Sanger's Two-Chain Disulfide Puzzle, Steiner & Oyer's 1967 Human Islet Tumor Pulse-Chase Proinsulin Precursor & Equimolar C-Peptide Secretion
item.description: Discovery of prohormone processing: why isolated insulin A and B chains recombine inefficiently in vitro, Steiner & Oyer (1967) identification of single-chain proinsulin in human islet-cell adenoma slices, pulse-chase proof of intracellular proteolytic conversion into two-chain insulin, and Rubenstein, Clark & Steiner (1969) equimolar C-peptide co-secretion enabling clinical distinction between endogenous and exogenous insulin.

item.title: How a Cell Passes a Message Inside — Sutherland & Rall's Broken-Cell Liver Homogenate Fractionation, Heat-Stable Cyclic AMP Transfer & Walsh's cAMP-Dependent Protein Kinase
item.description: Discovery of the second-messenger principle: Rall, Sutherland & Berthet (1957) two-stage cell-free assay separating particulate membrane hormone response from soluble phosphorylase activation via a dialyzable, heat-stable factor, Sutherland & Rall (1958) chemical identification of cyclic 3',5'-AMP, and Walsh, Perkins & Krebs (1968) discovery of cAMP-dependent protein kinase (PKA).

item.title: The Alarm Beyond the Wall — Post-Storm Portable Generator Exhaust Aerodynamics (167 Florida Cases, 16 Outdoor vs. 16 Garage), Wind-Wake Infiltration, Pulse Oximetry SpO2 Blindness & Battery CO Alarms
item.description: Forensic investigation of post-storm portable generator carbon monoxide infiltration: 2004 Florida hurricane hospital/CPSC records (167 nonfatal cases in 51 incidents; 16 outdoor vs. 16 garage generators), aerodynamic wake infiltration through windows and window AC units, two-wavelength pulse oximetry SpO2 optical blindness vs. CO-oximetry, and North Carolina ice-storm battery-backed CO alarm survival evidence.

item.title: The Gluten Fragment That Changed Its Charge — Celiac TG2 Cys277 Gln→Glu Deamidation, HLA-DQ2.5 Lysβ71 Pocket (1S9V), Irreversible ZED1227 Active-Site Trapping & Gluten-Challenge Biopsy Trials
item.description: Atomic pathogenesis and covalent enzyme inhibition in celiac disease: tissue transglutaminase 2 (TG2) Cys277 thioester deamidation of gliadin glutamine into negatively charged glutamate, HLA-DQ2.5 positively charged P4/P6/P7 pocket anchoring via Lysβ71 (PDB 1S9V), tTG-IgA vs. total IgA and Marsh/villus-height-to-crypt-depth morphometry, and Schuppan et al.'s (2021) NEJM ZED1227 trial.

item.title: The Fat Droplet That Wouldn't Let Go — PNPLA3 I148M Droplet Sequestration & ABHD5 Competition, Romeo's Dallas Heart Study Scan, MRI-PDFF vs. FIB-4 & AZD2693 Antisense FORTUNA Trial
item.description: Why knocking out Pnpla3 in mice did not cause fatty liver while human PNPLA3 I148M drives steatohepatitis: Romeo et al. (2008) 1H-MRS genetics, Ser47–Asp166 patatin dyad, ubiquitylation-resistant I148M accumulation on lipid droplets sequestering CGI-58/ABHD5 away from ATGL (Wang et al. 2019), and phase I/IIb GalNAc-ASO AZD2693 MRI-PDFF reductions vs. FORTUNA histologic fibrosis endpoints.

item.title: The Bowel That Learned to Absorb Again — Short-Bowel High-Output Jejunostomy Secretory Losses, GLP-2R Cryo-EM & Teduglutide Ala2→Gly2 DPP-4 Shielding & STEPS Parenteral Weaning
item.description: Intestinal rehabilitation in short-bowel syndrome with end-jejunostomy: net secretory stoma sodium/water balance vs. renal sodium conservation, colonic salvage anatomy, human GLP-2–GLP-2R–Gs cryo-EM structure and teduglutide Ala2→Gly2 DPP-4 resistance, villus height/crypt depth trophic remodeling, and Jeppesen's STEPS randomized parenteral-support reduction trial.

item.title: What the Section and the Scatter Saw — Tissue Biopsy, Cold Ischemia & Margin Geometry (H029), Flow Cytometry Clonality, MRD & Lineage Switch (H030) & Veterinary Helical CT Staging (V016)
item.description: One Medicine synthesis of tissue histopathology (H029), multiparameter flow cytometry (H030), and veterinary helical CT (V016): cold ischemia, formalin kinetics, Elmore's 240x115 breast biopsy concordance and STR floater checks; MBL, TRBC1, COG/EuroFlow MRD, and anti-CD19 lineage switch; and canine lung staging (41/459 nodules on X-ray), breath-hold recruitment, 66-dog portosystemic shunt CTA, and caval tumor-thrombus mapping.

item.title: The Piece the Camera Couldn't See — Normal-Appearing Mucosa in Eosinophilic Esophagitis (169 Eos/HPF, H047), Canine Pseudotumoral Bacterial Gastritis (V036) & Multilevel GI Biopsy Architecture
item.description: One Medicine gastrointestinal endoscopy and mucosal biopsy investigation (H047 & V036): why optically normal human esophageal mucosa can conceal severe eosinophilic esophagitis (169 eosinophils/HPF) unless multilevel biopsies are taken, why canine gastric masses mimicking neoplasia on endoscopy require submucosal histology and special stains, and patchy sampling error.

item.title: The Number After the Sting — Postmortem Tryptase Site Divergence (8,955 Antemortem vs. <5,000 Central vs. 319 Peripheral ng/mL), Systemic Mastocytosis Baselines & Anaphylaxis Thresholds
item.description: Forensic pathology and clinical toxicology of fatal insect-sting anaphylaxis: dramatic divergence between antemortem catheter blood (8,955 ng/mL), postmortem central blood (<5,000 ng/mL), and postmortem peripheral femoral blood (319 ng/mL), systemic mastocytosis baseline tryptase elevation, and why isolated postmortem cutoffs fail without anatomic sampling discipline.

item.title: The Pressure Behind the Reading — Human Bilateral Topiramate Angle-Closure Glaucoma (H052), Feline Post-Traumatic Hypotony & Lens Rupture (V033), Applanation vs. Rebound Tonometry & Ocular Ultrasound
item.description: One Medicine ophthalmic tonometry and structural imaging comparison (H052 & V033): Al-Naqeeb et al.
